findings.evidence: 연습할수록 실력/매력이 늘어요 are both natural.
날씨가 맑더니 갑자기/결국 천둥이 쳤어요 are both plausible sequence adverbs.
열심히 노력하더니 결국/갑자기 합격했어요 are both natural.
성공 경험이 쌓일수록 자신감/실력이 높아져요 are both natural.
The rule says adjectives are not used with -는 바람에 but the verb row gives 늦다 → 늦는 바람에; 늦다 is taught as an adjective, so the card contradicts itself.
findings.fix: Applied replacement with an unambiguous action-verb example 놓치다 → 놓치는 바람에.
